meta.generationNote: Dominican Republic NDC 3.0 (2025). 3rd generation per tracker rule (submission since Nov 2024).

rows.verbatim: reducir sus emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero (GEI) en un 28 % para 2030, equivalente a 14,732.1 kt CO₂ eq ... respecto al escenario de tendencia (BAU), tomando como referencia el año base 2022
rows.translation: Reduce GHG emissions by 28% by 2030 (14,732.1 kt CO2eq) relative to the BAU scenario, base year 2022
rows.note: Economy-wide 28%/2030 splits into 8.5% unconditional + 19.5% conditional (p14/16). This is the UNCONDITIONAL share (8.5%). Verbatim trimmed; see twin row for conditional share.

rows.verbatim: del compromiso de reducción de 28 %, un 8.5 % es no-condicionado, financiado con recursos nacionales y otras fuentes gestionadas por el país, y un 19.5 % condicionado
rows.translation: Of the 28% reduction commitment, 8.5% is unconditional (financed by national resources) and 19.5% is conditional
rows.note: CONDITIONAL share (19.5%) of the 28%/2030 economy-wide target. Twin of the unconditional row.

rows.verbatim: y en un 32 % al 2035, equivalente a 18,349.32 kt CO₂ eq, respecto al escenario de tendencia (BAU), tomando como referencia el año base 2022
rows.translation: and by 32% by 2035 (18,349.32 kt CO2eq) relative to the BAU scenario, base year 2022
rows.note: 32%/2035 economy-wide target. The document states the 8.5/19.5 split explicitly for the 28%/2030 only; 2035 conditionality is not separately quantified -> Unclear. Confirm whether to also split 2035.

rows.verbatim: Nuevos corredores de autobuses con tecnologías más eficientes a nivel nacional
rows.translation: New bus corridors with more efficient technologies nationwide (Corredor Independencia & 27 de Febrero, Santo Domingo; 174 buses; ~22,925.66 t CO2eq/yr)
rows.note: PAM 7. Detail p155: bus corridors with more efficient (still diesel) fleets, AMS-III.S methodology; also mentions initiating BRT studies and an electric corridor. Could be duplicated for a BRT-specific row if you want the BRT study captured separately.

rows.verbatim: Nuevas líneas de transporte masivo en grandes ciudades a través de líneas férreas
rows.translation: New mass-transit lines in large cities via rail (Santiago & Santo Domingo monorail; ~111,642 t CO2eq/yr avoided)
rows.note: PAM 8. Detail p156: Monorail Santiago (13.2 km) and Santo Domingo (10.5 km, links to Metro). ACM0016 mass rapid transit methodology. NOTE: taxonomy label is 'Public transit integration and expansion' — verify exact instrument label in console dropdown.

rows.verbatim: Nuevas líneas de transporte masivo en grandes ciudades a través del teleférico
rows.translation: New mass-transit lines in large cities via cableway/teleférico (km 9 Autopista Duarte to marginalized sectors; up to 4,500 passengers/hr/direction; ~11,343 t CO2eq/yr)
rows.note: PAM 9. Detail p157: cable car (teleférico), AMS-III.U Cable Cars for MRTS. Mode is ambiguous — cable car isn't cleanly 'rail'; consider 'Mode: Not defined' or transit rail. Flagged for mode decision.

rows.verbatim: Establecer programas para renovar y diseñar flotas de carga, incluyendo pilotos y estándares para nuevos modos de transportación
rows.translation: Establish programs to renew and design freight fleets, including pilots and standards for new transport modes (Fleet/Transport Management Systems pilot)
rows.note: PAM 10. Detail p158: Fleet Management Systems (FMS) + Transport Management Systems (TMS) pilot. Enabling-framework/non-GHG. Verify exact freight instrument label.

rows.verbatim: Articulación y marcos regulatorios para la inspección técnica vehicular y la estrategia de chatarrización
rows.translation: Coordination and regulatory frameworks for vehicle technical inspection and the scrappage strategy
rows.note: PAM 11. Bundled: vehicle technical inspection (ITV) + scrappage strategy. This is the INSPECTION half. Duplicate for the scrappage half (Vehicle scrappage scheme). Detail p159.

rows.verbatim: Articulación y marcos regulatorios para ... la estrategia de chatarrización
rows.translation: Coordination and regulatory frameworks for the scrappage strategy
rows.note: PAM 11 — SCRAPPAGE half (split from inspection). Twin of the inspection row.

rows.verbatim: Propuesta de incorporación del combustible sostenible de SAF y LCAF en la aviación doméstica dominicana
rows.translation: Proposal to incorporate sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and LCAF in Dominican domestic aviation (~1,000 t CO2eq reduction)
rows.note: PAM 12. Detail p160: SAF/LCAF mandate scheme, carbon credits, book-and-claim; sugarcane-based. Verify exact aviation instrument label (jet fuel policies vs general aviation).

rows.verbatim: Iniciar el estudio para el corredor eléctrico en la Av. Ecológica
rows.translation: Initiate the study for the electric corridor on Av. Ecológica
rows.note: Sub-activity within PAM 7: electric bus corridor study. Captured separately as electrification; may be merged into PAM 7 if you prefer one row.

rows.translation: efficient public transport corridors (listed among transport adaptation/resilience actions)
rows.note: From the resilience/co-benefit narrative (p67, p185, p216): efficient bus corridors framed as a less climate-vulnerable mobility network. Borderline adaptation — primarily mitigation. Flagged: confirm whether DR records this as an adaptation row.

rows.verbatim: Corredores de buses eficientes — Salud & calidad del aire: ↓ NOx/PM; Accesibilidad; tarifas justas
rows.translation: Efficient bus corridors — health & air quality co-benefit (lower NOx/PM); accessibility; fair fares
rows.note: Co-benefits annex (Anexo 3, p185) ties efficient bus corridors to air-quality (NOx/PM reduction). Also implies accessibility & social inclusion — duplicate if you want those benefit tags too.

rows.verbatim: la integración territorial mediante teleféricos, monorrieles y corredores de buses mejora la accesibilidad a empleo y servicios en barrios periféricos
rows.translation: Territorial integration via cableways, monorails and bus corridors improves access to jobs and services in peripheral neighborhoods
rows.note: p67: explicit accessibility co-benefit of the mass-transit measures (teleférico, monorail, bus corridors). Could also tag 'Better social inclusion'.
